name: Zupaysaurus
sum: Early theropod from the Late Triassic Los Colorados Formation of Argentina, up to 4 m long.
wsnote: Up to 4 m according to Wikipedia revision 1384612343.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: A full skeleton has not been found.
author: Arcucci and Coria 2003
